acquisition_method: inferred: The Q-Exactive was operated in a data-dependent mode
alkylation_reagent: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT and 15 μg of iodoacetamide
cleavage_agent: Resulting protein pellets were reduced, alkylated, and subjected to trypsin digestion before being analyzed by LC-MS/MS.
collision_energy: the collision energy ranged from 23 to 65 eV depending on ion mass and charge.
enrichment_method: incubated with the desired antibody or IgG as a control overnight at 4 °C.
fractionation_method: Peptides from each biological replicate were then subjected to high pH reverse-phase (RP) fractionation
fragmentation_method: fragment the top ten multiply charged ions above 5% underfill ratio by HCD
instrument: Purified peptides were analyzed using an Easy nano LC 1000 nanoflow HPLC (Thermo Fisher) on-line coupled to a Q-Exactive mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
ionization_type: The nano ESI source was operated at 1900 V capillary voltage
labeling: For SILAC experiments, cells were stimulated in the appropriate SILAC-formulated media.
ptm: carbamidomethylation, methionine oxidation, deamidation (NQ), and N-acetylation
fixed modifications, carbamidomethyl; variable modifications, methionine oxidation, deamidation (NQ), and N-acetylation (protein N-terminus)
reduction_reagent: Samples were reduced and alkylated by adding 6 μg of DTT
